prompt: What is the largest work by Italian artist Leonardo da Vinci that is considered an archetypal masterpiece of the Italian Renaissance?
answer: **The Last Supper** (*Il Cenacolo*), painted by Leonardo da Vinci around **1495–1498**, is his largest completed work and an archetypal masterpiece of the Italian Renaissance. It covers the refectory wall of the convent of **Santa Maria delle Grazie in Milan**.
